behavior.originalPreference: Declared PNG is read first; only exact-path nonredirected404 may use a current code-owned matching path/bytes/SHA256 descriptor.
behavior.refusal: Unavailable503, redirected responses, wrong locators/pins, corrupt original bytes and corrupt fallback pack pins cannot acquire a broader fallback.
behavior.identity: Native source/pack/media resolution remains unchanged. Display bytes are rechecked for length, SHA256, PNG dimensions and browser decode; no installation or assessment is written.
behavior.ownership: Temporary native decodes and final displayed previews own their object URLs. Reveal gallery is lazy and sequential; hidden/BFCache departure cancels pending work, replacement/final departure disposes adopted images, late completion cannot adopt.

checks.eslint: Affected scripts/tests passed repository rules; authoring modules passed browser-global no-undef/no-unreachable rules.
checks.prettier: All affected source, HTML, locale and test files passed.
checks.localization: Existing localization build completed; both EN/UK copy and generated catalogs were refreshed; content registry unchanged.

scope: Representative production embedded original and selected external gallery/viewer original; not every omitted image receives browser pixel qualification.
Only lazy in-view gallery images are loaded; this is not all21 thumbnails.
Final pagehide is dispatched by the probe; actual navigation/BFCache has separate qualification.
URL instrumentation retains active Blob references for hashing and records global counts separately from preview allocation-stack ownership.
Source hashes cover the listed consumer/resolver/locale/tool files, not the whole repository.
Storage comparison covers localStorage/sessionStorage; this probe does not inspect all IndexedDB records.

coverage.browser: Representative Production optional embedded PNG and external Sentinel Reveal image/viewer; four lazy gallery images observed out of21. This is not all33 browser renderings.
coverage.finalDeparture: Synthetic pagehide exercises real registered cleanup handlers; no actual BFCache or physical device claim.

failedAndRetained.reason: Observer fetch(blobURL) refused under public CSP. Final observer hashes allocation Blob keyed by displayed live src instead.
Initial zero-global-URL assertion included legitimate unrelated page presentation URLs. Final probe checks preview allocation-stack ownership and reports global counts independently.
Generic source preview server did not admit retained optional native pack paths. Final task-owned fixture serves only exact code-owned pinned originals/pack/media.
Generic source preview server likewise refused retained historical source PNGs. Finite pinned original serving fixed the fixture; no consumer permission was widened.

limitations: Source hash bindings are limited to the explicit consumer/resolver/locale/tool files in the browser receipt, not a full emitted-build fingerprint.
The fixture is not a generated main-pages or offline workshop installation proof; packaging has separate evidence.
URL-stack attribution is scoped ownership instrumentation and retains live Blob references for hashing; it is not exhaustive page heap, GPU or detached-node accounting.
Local/session storage snapshots are exact; this probe does not compare every IndexedDB record.
